title: 東京灣跨海公路隧道
summary: 東京灣跨海公路結合海底隧道、人工島與橋梁，大林組工程史列整體道路15.1公里及1997年施工標竣工。本課把整體走廊與承包商施工範圍分開，聚焦人工島支承、地下接合、環片與止水、通風和鹽害；不把某一標段紀錄泛化為整個工程所有部位的參數。
summaryEn: The Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line combines a subsea tunnel, artificial islands and a bridge. Obayashi records a 15.1 km road corridor and completion of its contract in 1997. The course separates corridor and contract scope, focusing on island support, underground connections, segments, sealing, ventilation and marine deterioration without generalising one contract to every structure.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.16 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.16 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.16 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.16 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure.
quiz.explanation: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed.
quiz.explanation: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
